decisions.reason: A navigation and observation camera close to the core business costs little to keep on offer and still holds uncertain upside in long space procurement cycles.
The modular camera line has flight heritage from ESA's HERA mission, which resolves uncertainty in its favor and justifies further commitment.
Space situational awareness is a growing market, so this option is worth keeping open while demand is still uncertain.
The miniaturized LiDAR fits the firm's push toward smaller satellites, and it is cheap to keep despite getting only website mentions so far.
The radiation-hard camera line launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its value has not yet been revealed and keeping it costs little.
The asteroid navigation camera is tied to specific missions and its prospects remain unresolved, so the low-cost option is kept rather than abandoned prematurely.
